hints = [
    # At most one link can be active at a time (pairwise mutex for all pairs)
    Or(Not(bool_var("link[0]")), Not(bool_var("link[1]"))),
    Or(Not(bool_var("link[0]")), Not(bool_var("link[2]"))),
    Or(Not(bool_var("link[0]")), Not(bool_var("link[3]"))),
    Or(Not(bool_var("link[1]")), Not(bool_var("link[2]"))),
    Or(Not(bool_var("link[1]")), Not(bool_var("link[3]"))),
    Or(Not(bool_var("link[2]")), Not(bool_var("link[3]"))),

    # If semaphore is set (free), no link can be active
    # semaphore=1 means no client is connected
    Or(Not(bool_var("semaphore")), Not(bool_var("link[0]"))),
    Or(Not(bool_var("semaphore")), Not(bool_var("link[1]"))),
    Or(Not(bool_var("semaphore")), Not(bool_var("link[2]"))),
    Or(Not(bool_var("semaphore")), Not(bool_var("link[3]"))),

    # If any link is active, semaphore must be held (cleared)
    # i.e., link[i] -> !semaphore
    Implies(bool_var("link[0]"), Not(bool_var("semaphore"))),
    Implies(bool_var("link[1]"), Not(bool_var("semaphore"))),
    Implies(bool_var("link[2]"), Not(bool_var("semaphore"))),
    Implies(bool_var("link[3]"), Not(bool_var("semaphore"))),

    # At most one link is active — combined with semaphore state:
    # if link[i] is set, semaphore is clear AND all other links are clear
    Implies(bool_var("link[0]"), And(Not(bool_var("semaphore")), Not(bool_var("link[1]")), Not(bool_var("link[2]")), Not(bool_var("link[3]")))),
    Implies(bool_var("link[1]"), And(Not(bool_var("semaphore")), Not(bool_var("link[0]")), Not(bool_var("link[2]")), Not(bool_var("link[3]")))),
    Implies(bool_var("link[2]"), And(Not(bool_var("semaphore")), Not(bool_var("link[0]")), Not(bool_var("link[1]")), Not(bool_var("link[3]")))),
    Implies(bool_var("link[3]"), And(Not(bool_var("semaphore")), Not(bool_var("link[0]")), Not(bool_var("link[1]")), Not(bool_var("link[2]")))),

    # Semaphore is free iff no link is active (the full characterization)
    # semaphore -> all links cleared
    Implies(bool_var("semaphore"), And(Not(bool_var("link[0]")), Not(bool_var("link[1]")), Not(bool_var("link[2]")), Not(bool_var("link[3]")))),

    # Converse: if no link is active, semaphore should be set (free)
    # This rules out the "all clear but semaphore also clear" ghost state
    Or(bool_var("semaphore"), bool_var("link[0]"), bool_var("link[1]"), bool_var("link[2]"), bool_var("link[3]")),
]
